full_page.content:
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
1950, October 11
POST CARD
Mrs. Martha - O.B.J. - Casey 516 Warren Ave. Seattle 9, Washington.
Blessed be God in all His designs
Oct. 1l# 1950. God bless you Martha -
Many thanks for your kind favor - duly received and noted. I do hope you all keep well - avoiding worry and too much ambition. .... Fr. E'd was down a couple days at Christmas, seems to have enjoyed visit. Am writing him Tonight - his Name day is the 13# E'd.
Love and God's blessing to all - special of course to Owen B. J. and B.M. and to Brother Pat. and poor, dear Genevieve.
... Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
